name: Heavy Metro
description: Deep-level tube train capable of running the UK's most frequent rail service. Modeled after the London Underground's Victoria Line 2009 Stock.

name: Light Metro
description: Small, automated metro systems built to negotiate tight urban alignments. Modeled after the Dockland Light Railway's B07 Stock.

name: Light Rail
description: Lighter rapid transit suitable for smaller cities. Modeled after the Bombardier M5000 used on the Manchester Metrolink.

name: Electric Commuter Rail
description: Modern commuter train designed for outer suburban as well as intensive urban operations. Modeled after the Elizabeth Line's Class 345.

name: Diesel Commuter Rail
description: Classic DMU for lower-demand regional routes. Modeled after the Class 150 Sprinter.
